notes: One row per ring request row of v1.json that ringvec encodes, in ringvec's input format (ring-py-node-drivers-design.md section 2b): each row's input encodes to exactly its payload_hex.

Byte members are hex and end in _hex; a BSON document (filter, where) is canonical Extended JSON; a number is the wire member's width; an enum is the wire number, never a name; a missing member is the Go zero value, exactly as the codec defaults it.

RING_TOPOLOGY (222) is absent: hoarddb-wire has no request codec for it, so neither ringvec nor a driver can form it. RING_REPLY (223) answers a request and is never one. CLUSTER_PROBE is node to node and no driver sends it.

An intent is a request a typed API can form and hoarddb-wire refuses; refused.message is the codec's own text, which ringvec and decode-reply print unchanged. A server-canonical refusal is bytes no typed API can produce (a reordered member, a widened integer, a written default, an extra member, a truncated body or a trailing byte), so it carries no input. An undecodable_request is an exchange whose request the server refuses whole (a lying or truncated frame), which no typed API produces either.

intents.row: ring keyed refused: a peek of more than 100

refused.name: INVALID_ARGUMENT
refused.message: read class 0x82 asks for count 101 and it must be 1 to 100

intents.row: ring keyed refused: an unknown class byte

refused.name: INVALID_ARGUMENT
refused.message: request class 0x7f is neither a write (0x01 to 0x09) nor a read (0x81 to 0x84, 0x87 to 0x8B). Nothing was done; send a class from one of those ranges

intents.row: ring batch refused: a count of zero

refused.name: INVALID_ARGUMENT
refused.message: a batch carries at least one operation and this one has none. Nothing was sent; send one to 255 write operations, or use a RING_KEYED for a single read

intents.row: ring batch refused: a read class

refused.name: INVALID_ARGUMENT
refused.message: operation 0 of the batch: operation class 0x81 is not one of the nine write classes, 0x01 (insert) to 0x09 (extend). Nothing was written; send one of those classes

intents.row: ring admin refused: an alter with nothing in it

refused.name: INVALID_ARGUMENT
refused.message: alter_bucket: add and drop are both empty, so there is nothing to change. Send a field to add as {name, type}, or the name of a field to drop, or expire_field or drop_expire to change the expiry

intents.row: ring admin refused: an alter without its drop list

refused.name: INVALID_ARGUMENT
refused.message: alter_bucket: add and drop are both required. Send add as an array of {name, type} and drop as an array of field names, either empty

intents.row: ring admin refused: an extra member

refused.name: INVALID_ARGUMENT
refused.message: create_database takes only name rf storage and cmd, and this request also sets database. Remove database

intents.row: ring admin refused: an unknown command

refused.name: INVALID_ARGUMENT
refused.message: cmd "drop_database" is not an admin command. Send one of create_database, create_bucket, alter_bucket, drop_bucket, describe_bucket, show_buckets, show_databases, describe_database, describe_node, seeding_status, seeding_retry, seeding_forget, join, promote, leave, remove_node or replace_node

refused.name: INVALID_ARGUMENT

intents.row: ring keyed refused: get_fields with no names

refused.name: INVALID_ARGUMENT

intents.row: ring admin refused: a seeding retry without its slot

refused.name: INVALID_ARGUMENT
refused.message: seeding_retry needs a slot, 0 to 8191, and this request has none. Run 'status seeding' to list the slots of this node, then send one of them

intents.row: ring admin refused: a seeding slot past the last

refused.name: INVALID_ARGUMENT
refused.message: seeding_forget: slot is 8192 and a slot is 0 to 8191. Send a slot 'status seeding' lists

intents.row: ring admin refused: a seeding status slot without a database

refused.name: INVALID_ARGUMENT
refused.message: seeding_status: a slot needs the database it belongs to, and this request names none. Send database with slot, or leave both out

intents.row: ring admin refused: a join without its address

refused.name: INVALID_ARGUMENT
refused.message: join: data_addr is 0 bytes and it is 1 to 256. Send host:port, the address the node serves the cluster on, for example node-b.example:4433

intents.row: ring admin refused: a join address with port 0

refused.name: INVALID_ARGUMENT
refused.message: join: data_addr "node-b.example:0" has port "0" and a port is 1 to 65535. Send host:port, for example node-b.example:4433

intents.row: ring admin refused: a promote with an address

refused.name: INVALID_ARGUMENT
refused.message: promote takes only node_id and cmd, and this request also sets data_addr. Remove data_addr

intents.row: ring admin refused: a replace_node that is a witness

refused.name: INVALID_ARGUMENT
refused.message: replace_node takes no witness, which only join takes. Remove witness; a node is made a witness when it joins

refused.name: INVALID_ARGUMENT
